projects.title: Impact of a Text-Messaging Program on Patient Adherence to Antidepressant Medications in an Urban Patient-Centered Medical Home
projects.description:
Harbor Health Services, Mattapan, MA

- Developed and assessed the effect of a text-message intervention on medication adherence
- Drafted IRB approval, proposals, and a manuscript with research protocols
- Presented findings at the American Pharmacists Association Annual Meeting and Exposition in San Francisco, CA and at the Research, Innovation, Scholarship Exposition at Northeastern University, MA.
